|game_text=Deploy on table. [[Floating Refinery]] is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector, or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control two cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata versions are [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). The images here (the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image) show this text; the errata texts are shown by CardMaker recreations on their pages.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector, or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control two cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The slip prints the deploy icon (▼) and the Immune to Alter icon; the wiki writes them out (“deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, “(Immune to Alter.)”), as the card list does.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “suspended during opponent's turn” to “suspended on opponent's turn”. PC-E1 text: “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended on opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector, or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control two cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1220_36-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed the original “deploy one Floating” to “deploy a Floating”, “a non-unique cloud” to “a cloud” and “sector,” to “sector (to Bespin),”; it keeps the printed “suspended during opponent's turn”. PC-E2 text: “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy a Floating Refinery, a cloud sector (to Bespin), or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control two cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
